verdict.rationale: The changelog says you can list the regions available to a database and its configured Vitess read-only regions, which implies databases are tied to selectable regions. The homepage also mentions bring-your-own-cloud via PlanetScale Managed, which would let you control where data lives. Neither source explicitly documents choosing a primary region at creation or offering data-residency guarantees. Missing for 10: explicit docs on selecting a database region at creation, data-residency/compliance guarantees, a list of supported regions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
